name: Superhero
definition: An individual character record in the comic-book character database, identified by the surrogate integer key superhero.id.
scope: Character-level analysis across publishers, powers, rated attributes and physical measurements.

name: Superhero Name
definition: The published codename or alias of a character, stored as free text in superhero.superhero_name. It is always populated but is not unique across characters.
scope: Identifying and grouping characters by their published alias.

name: Full Name (civil identity)
definition: The civil or real name of a character when known. The literal string '-' is a placeholder for characters whose real name is not recorded, and NULL means the same.
scope: Questions about a character's real-world identity or secret identity.

name: Publisher
definition: The comic-book or media company that owns a character, held in the publisher lookup table.
scope: Grouping and comparing characters by their publishing company.

name: Rated Attribute
definition: One of six named capability dimensions - Intelligence, Strength, Speed, Durability, Power and Combat - used to rate characters.
scope: Attribute-level analysis of character capability.

name: Attribute Score
definition: The integer rating assigned to one character on one attribute, stored in hero_attribute.attribute_value.
scope: Available only for characters that have rows in hero_attribute; each covered character has all six attributes.

name: Superpower
definition: A named ability drawn from the superpower vocabulary that a character may possess.
scope: Ability-level analysis; powers are a shared vocabulary reusable across many characters.

name: Superpower Count
definition: The number of distinct superpowers associated with a character. No stored column exists; it must be derived from the character-power association.
scope: Comparing characters by breadth of abilities.

name: Overall Attribute Score
definition: An aggregate of a character's six attribute scores, used to summarise general capability. No such total is stored and it must be derived per character.
scope: Only meaningful for the 623 characters that carry attribute scores.

name: Race / Species
definition: The species or origin classification of a character. The value '-' denotes an unclassified race rather than a species named '-'.
scope: Species-based grouping and comparison of characters.

name: Alignment
definition: The moral alignment of a character: Good, Bad or Neutral.
scope: Comparing heroic and villainous populations; 6 characters carry no alignment at all.

name: Gender
definition: The gender category of a character: Male, Female, or the sentinel value 'N/A' for unspecified.
scope: Gender-based grouping and comparison.

name: Colour Vocabulary
definition: The shared colour vocabulary used for eye, hair and skin colour. The value 'No Colour' denotes an absent or not-applicable colour rather than an actual colour.
scope: Any colour-facet analysis of characters.

name: Eye Colour
definition: The eye colour of a character, drawn from the shared colour vocabulary through superhero.eye_colour_id.
scope: Eye-colour facet of a character.

name: Hair Colour
definition: The hair colour of a character, drawn from the shared colour vocabulary through superhero.hair_colour_id.
scope: Hair-colour facet of a character.

name: Skin Colour
definition: The skin colour of a character, drawn from the shared colour vocabulary through superhero.skin_colour_id.
scope: Skin-colour facet of a character; 'No Colour' dominates this facet.

name: Height
definition: The height of a character expressed in centimetres. A stored value of 0 and a NULL both denote an unrecorded height rather than a real measurement.
scope: Character size analysis; must be filtered for missing and extreme values.

name: Weight
definition: The weight of a character expressed in kilograms. A stored value of 0 and a NULL both denote an unrecorded weight rather than a real measurement.
scope: Character size analysis; must be filtered for missing and extreme values.

name: Hero Count
definition: The number of distinct character records held in the main superhero table.
scope: Population sizing; counted on the surrogate key, not on names.

name: Dash Placeholder
definition: The literal '-' string used throughout text columns as a placeholder meaning 'value unknown or not applicable'.
scope: Applies to superhero.full_name and race.race; must be excluded from literal string matching.

name: Not-Applicable Placeholder
definition: The 'N/A', 'No Colour' and empty-string vocabulary entries that mean 'value unknown or not applicable' rather than a real category.
scope: Applies to gender.gender, alignment.alignment, colour.colour and publisher.publisher_name.
